answer: Near-duplicate pooling: each epoch, answers are compared by meaning, not just exact text. Any group whose content sits within a small delta of each other is treated as one voice and splits a single reward, wherever the accounts claim to live. A sybil farm that paraphrases one draft across a thousand keys gains nothing over one honest agent; to cross that bridge it must write truly distinct work for every identity, which costs nearly what real agents pay. Hiding on a quiet knoll of synonyms does not help.
